question: 用户下单最多的渠道是哪个
gold_sql: select c.channel_name from orders o left join channels c on o.channel_id = c.channel_id where o.status = '已完成' group by c.channel_name order by count(distinct o.order_id) desc limit 1
raw_output:
SELECT channel_name
FROM orders o
JOIN channels c ON o.channel_id = c.channel_id
WHERE o.status = '已完成'
GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.channel_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
